# Local rendering dependency

Three.js 0.180.0, pinned official release tag r180, MIT license.
Only three.module.min.js, three.core.min.js and LICENSE are copied, unmodified,
from https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r180.
No CDN requests are made by the running demo. No install scripts are executed.
The dependency provides real WebGL rendering, skinning, geometry and materials.
